name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ウォーグレイモン

description.ja: 『デジモンアドベンチャー』より、アニメ設定を元に立体化したFigure-rise Standardシリーズとして「ウォーグレイモン」が第１弾で登場！
description.en: From "Digimon Adventure ", " War Greymon" is the first in the Figure-rise Standard series, which is three-dimensional based on the anime setting!

description.ja: ■背中のブレイブシールドは左右に開閉可能。
description.en: • The Brave Seal on the back can be opened and closed to the left and right.

description.ja: ■各関節パーツが広範囲に可動。劇中の様々なアクションポーズが再現できる。
description.en: • Each joint part can move over a wide range. Various action poses from the movie can be reproduced.

description.ja: ■組み立てるだけで満足できるパーツ分割。
description.en: • Part division that can be satisfied just by assembling.
